expected_findings.description: List concatenation `stack[i:] + [nxt]` violates RUF005 rule; should use `[*stack[i:], nxt]` instead.
All 8 test functions lack `-> None` return-type annotations, inconsistent with other test files in the project.
One-line docstring uses ASCII `->` inconsistently with Unicode `→` used elsewhere.
